_doc: Bug-class × platform EV multipliers (Doctrine #75) WITH the exploration floor + confidence gate (Doctrine #78, Ogie intake-v2 2026-06-23). mem_type: semantic. A measured loop with no exploration term converges on its own tiny history and dies — so down-weights from near-zero n are pulled toward neutral and never fully foreclosed by statistics alone. Applied at the GATE-1 hypothesis-EV level (not the program scorer). Updated by scripts/lane1/post-mortem.py.

exploration_floor.justification: Below ~0.30 a class is effectively never selected over a neutral one (3x under-weighted in realizable_ev × mult) -> starvation -> never re-sampled -> the down-weight becomes self-fulfilling. 0.30 keeps a down-weighted class ALIVE in the ranking; the 20% exploration slice then guarantees real re-sampling. NO class is fully foreclosed by ev-weights alone.
exploration_floor.structural_foreclosure_exempt: Only a #72-style STRUCTURAL fact (admin-set/safe-by-design custody) or a channel that structurally cannot receive a security report (general-inbox email) may go below the floor — flagged `structural:true`, kept SEPARATE from statistical weight.

confidence_gate.rule: A multiplier may only move far from 1.0 once n crosses a threshold (low-n shrinkage toward the neutral prior).
confidence_gate.justification: n<3 = ~no signal (1-2 draws) -> stay near-neutral + ride the exploration slice; n>=6 = enough to commit to a strong weight.

exploration_slice.rule: 1 in 5 hunt cycles IGNORES ev-weights entirely and samples the LEAST-observed bug-class / target (lowest n), so weights keep getting real data. epsilon-greedy = 0.2.
exploration_slice.justification: With ~10 tracked classes, 20% explore re-samples every class within ~50 cycles without over-spending; standard explore/exploit balance.

update_rule.note: Multiplicative, THEN clamped by the confidence_gate (by n), THEN floored at 0.30 (structural-exempt). One observation nudges; n must accumulate before a weight commits.

http_protocol_state.basis: 1/1 PAID (DISC-016 Firedancer Insight). Gate n<3 caps at 1.20 (was hand-set 1.30 on n=1). Novel class, thin target = the positive selection prior (#79).

slippage_double_count.basis: 0/2 (DISC-021/022 misframe+invalid). Gate n<3 + floor lift it from a self-fulfilling 0.20 to 0.70 — 2 unlucky draws, NOT a dead class. Per-hypothesis #43 aggregate-bound gate still applies structurally.

dc7_validating_vs_consuming.basis: 0/3 (DISC-008 closed-info, DISC-015 OOS, DISC-015b dup). n=3 -> [0.4,1.4] -> 0.54.

signature_replay.basis: 0/2 DUP (DISC-009/011 crowded marquees). Gate n<3 -> 0.72. Viable on THIN targets + first-to-report.

oracle_engineered_staleness.basis: 0/1 AI-Report-dismissal (DISC-019). Class not disproven; the REPORT failed -> #74.

validation_coverage_asymmetry.basis: DISC-012 Drift no-response + DISC-002 Sui rep-blocked.

ercVault_inflation_candidateI.basis: untested in submissions (foreclosed by #72 custody NEGATEs structurally, not statistically). Neutral.

default_novel_unhunted.basis: the one win was a NOVEL class on a THIN target -> intentional positive prior for genuinely-novel classes (#79). Within the n<3 band.

immunefi.basis: n>=6 band. The payout lane (DISC-016) but several AI-dismissals/OOS pull it slightly sub-neutral; AI-Report risk handled by #74 not a platform penalty.

sherlock.basis: contest-judged; fresh-by-design; repo access-gated (secure transfer EARLY).

hackerone.basis: n>=6: crowded marquee (OKX/Arc/Circle) high-dup + first-to-report races lost. Floored, genuinely down.

email_general_inbox.basis: STRUCTURAL-FORECLOSURE (exempt from the 0.30 floor): a general/support inbox structurally cannot receive a security disclosure (DISC-012/013 0/2 no-response). #77 foreclosed the lane.

history: 2026-06-23 v2 (#78): applied confidence-gate (low-n shrinkage) + 0.30 floor + 20% exploration slice. All statistical classes pulled to [0.54,1.20] (no near-zeros). email flagged structural (exempt). Before/after recorded in `v1_was`.
